evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies CWallet::FillPSBT in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp to populate PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB fixes signing failures on hardware signers like BitBox02 and eliminates manual xpub injection workarounds in coordinators like Specter Desktop. Author testing shows BitBox02 refuses to sign 2-of-3 multisig transactions without this field and Trezor T receives invalid zeroed chain codes for change outputs (issue #27583).
